about: The collecta of the formulary “Third Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, almighty God, look upon the desires of the humble and stretch forth the right hand of Thy majesty for our defense. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
